data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific journal figure to repair the layout and make the forward data flow unambiguous, while preserving the polished white-background vector-like style, teal/orange rounded frames, wall/aperture sketch, active stereo sensing pictorial, and all phenomenon thumbnails. Keep the overall composition and visual quality high, but fix arrows, labels, and grouping as follows:

LEFT SIDE: make it a clean input stack with four independent context items, each with its own black arrow into the corresponding row/module. Do not create a blocked routing area.
1) Native renderer R -> raw depth D_raw. Show as a geometry stream / native renderer input and a raw depth thumbnail.
2) scene/material mask Omega. Show as a separate mask input thumbnail.
3) speed ||v_t||. Show as a small standalone speed input.
4) camera registers c=[P,E,G] with P, E, G controls. This box must only send arrows outward to S_phi rows; no arrows may enter this box. D_raw and Omega must NOT enter the camera-register box.

CORRECT S_phi ROW DEPENDENCIES: Arrange five teal-framed rows with clear arrowheads into each row from the correct inputs. Row labels should be clean and readable.
- active return row receives P and D_raw; label exactly "(P, D_raw)".
- ambient washout row receives E and Omega; label exactly "(E, Omega)".
- motion blur row receives E and speed ||v_t||; label exactly "(E, ||v_t||)".
- gain/noise row receives G; label exactly "(G)".
- edge difficulty row receives D_raw; label exactly "(D_raw)".
Add a clear bracket/common combiner on the right side of these five rows that jointly produces quality Q. Keep the five phenomenon thumbnails: active return / range attenuation, ambient washout / stray illumination, motion blur / scene-object motion, gain/noise / SNR, edge difficulty / depth discontinuity.

RIGHT SIDE OUTPUT CHAIN: Draw a clean vertical chain Q -> soft validity M -> straight-through mask M_ST. Then M_ST should feed both observed outputs as a gate/mask. Draw D_raw as a thin fixed-depth input to the D_obs composition only. Draw Q as a thin quality input to the Q_obs composition only. Avoid any line that suggests Q directly creates D_obs. Use these exact compact equations only:
"Q = clip(Q0 + Omega C_rho, 0, 1)"
"M = sigmoid((Q - q0) / sigma_q)"
"D_obs = D_raw x M_ST"
"Q_obs = Q x M_ST"

STRICT EXCLUSIONS: no red arrows, no gradient/backward path, no loss box, no arrows into camera registers, no dense formulas or paragraph text, no generic icons replacing the phenomenon thumbnails.

STYLE: top-tier SCI/CS journal method figure, clean vector-like diagram, large readable labels, aligned modules, clear arrowheads, preserve the pictorial active stereo sensing scene with IR projector and wall/aperture target, preserve raw depth grayscale thumbnail, scene mask thumbnail, quality, validity, observed depth, and observed quality map thumbnails. Reposition elements as needed for correctness and clarity.
